title: Decontamination Basics
description: Step-by-step self-decontamination after chemical, biological, or radiological exposure: remove and double-bag clothing, wash gently with soap and water, flush eyes, and know when to call Poison Control or 911. Covers differences by contamination type, children, pets, wounds, and safely helping others.
shortDescription: Clothes off within 10 minutes, double-bag, wash 2-3 minutes, flush eyes
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
